categories.main_business_segments: Haichang Ocean Park Holdings Ltd. operates primarily in three segments: park operation, which includes development, construction, and operation of theme parks, hotel operation, and management of commercial and rental properties; tourism and leisure services and solutions, providing planning, design, construction, animal conservation, and operation management services; and property development, involving property construction and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages integrated oceanic culture-based tourism concepts, combining theme park design, animal conservation, and IP (intellectual property) integration. It employs advanced theme park construction and operation methods, including immersive entertainment shows, IP-themed pavilions and hotels, and digital engagement through online platforms and live streaming. The Group also focuses on breeding and conservation of marine animals as part of its core operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are domestic tourists and families seeking high-quality cultural and leisure experiences in China. The Group serves visitors to its seven large- and medium-scale marine culture-based tourism projects, hotels, and commercial properties. It also targets partners and clients for its tourism and leisure services and solutions business, including local governments and state-owned enterprises involved in cultural tourism development.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates mainly in Mainland China with seven theme parks located in major cities including Shanghai, Zhengzhou, Dalian, Sanya, Chongqing, and Yantai. It also has ongoing and planned projects in Beijing, Fuzhou, Ningbo, and international expansion plans including Saudi Arabia. Over 99% of its revenue and non-current assets are derived from and located in Mainland China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haichang Ocean Park Holdings Ltd. operates primarily downstream in the tourism and leisure supply chain, focusing on theme park operation, hotel management, and consumer entertainment services. It also engages midstream by providing tourism and leisure services and solutions, including planning, design, and management consultancy for cultural tourism projects.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group’s strategic focus is on expanding its flagship theme parks and developing an asset-light OAAS (Operation as a Service) business model. It emphasizes IP integration, partnering with internationally renowned IPs like ULTRAMAN, ONE PIECE, and others to enhance visitor experience and diversify revenue streams. The Group is also advancing digital innovation, online sales channels, and immersive entertainment to strengthen market competitiveness and sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through ticket sales, in-park spending (food, beverage, merchandise, recreation), hotel operations, rental income from commercial properties, and fees from tourism and leisure services and solutions. The Group also consolidates revenue from OAAS projects where it operates parks owned and invested by partners. Online sales and IP-related merchandise and events contribute to diversified income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haichang is positioned as a leading integrated oceanic culture-based tourism and leisure group in China, ranking among the top domestic theme parks with Shanghai Park in the Asia-Pacific top 20. It competes with other major theme park operators and cultural tourism groups in China, leveraging its strong IP portfolio and diversified business model to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB1.818 billion, a slight increase of 0.1% from 2023, driven by full-year operation of the Zhengzhou Park and growth in OAAS projects. The Group recorded a loss of RMB749.5 million, impacted by increased costs and impairment charges. Total assets were RMB10.34 billion with equity of RMB1.82 billion. The Group is in a growth phase with several major projects under construction or planned, including Shanghai Park Phase II and Beijing Project.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haichang Ocean Park Holdings Ltd. differentiates itself by offering integrated oceanic culture-themed tourism experiences combining marine animal conservation, immersive entertainment, and internationally licensed IPs. Its unique value lies in high-quality theme parks, innovative IP-themed hotels and pavilions, and a comprehensive OAAS business model that extends its expertise nationwide. The Group emphasizes creating joyful, family-friendly environments with strong brand recognition and digital engagement to enhance visitor satisfaction.
